articles.title: Article: Why Vector Search Alone Isn't Enough: Hybrid Retrieval for RAG
articles.reason: This article provides actionable guidance on improving RAG pipelines with hybrid retrieval, directly relevant to building robust enterprise GenAI solutions for finance and insurance clients.

These insights are directly applicable to optimizing existing or planned RAG implementations for enterprise use cases.

articles.title: BadHost Vulnerability Exposes AI Agents, Evaluators, and LLM Gateways
articles.reason: This vulnerability directly impacts the security of AI agent infrastructure, including RAG systems and LLM gateways, which are core to the consultant's enterprise deployments.
articles.summary: The BadHost vulnerability in Starlette exposes AI agent and LLM gateway deployments to authentication bypass via malformed Host headers, potentially compromising sensitive enterprise AI workflows. Since Starlette is a common backend for Python-based AI systems, including those built with LangGraph or FastAPI, this issue is highly relevant for securing production environments. Immediate mitigation is critical for any client-facing or internal AI services using Starlette.
actionable_insights: Audit all AI agent, RAG, and LLM gateway deployments for Starlette usage and apply the latest security patches.
Review and harden HTTP Host header validation in all Python-based AI services, especially those exposed to external traffic.
Communicate with clients about potential exposure and document remediation steps for compliance and risk management.
